defect: DEFECT: Lam-Alef ligature (U+FEFB / U+FEFC) is NOT implemented; Lam and Alef are kept as separate glyphs.

LIMITATION: Kashmiri Perso-Arabic vowels and special consonants ['Kashmiri Waaw with small circle (ۆ)', 'Kashmiri Yeh with tail (ؠ)', 'Kashmiri Yeh with small V (ء)', 'Kashmiri Wavy Hamza below (◌ٟ)', 'Kashmiri Kashmiri Yeh (ؠ)'] are NOT supported in custom shaper.

LIMITATION: Sindhi Perso-Arabic letters (13 characters: ['Sindhi Be / Tteh (ٻ)', 'Sindhi Pe / Theh (ٿ)', 'Sindhi Te / Tteh (ٺ)', 'Sindhi Be with 4 dots (ٽ)', 'Sindhi Jye / Nye (ڄ)']...) are completely absent from the custom shaper.

ARCHITECTURAL FINDING: ReportLab renders Urdu in Tahoma/Arial, which are standard Arabic NASKH fonts. True Nastaliq calligraphic layout is NOT supported in PDF/ReportLab due to lack of an OpenType Nastaliq shaping engine in ReportLab.
